BrochureContent.Content:
Set amidst approximately 12 acres of private grounds, this impressive stone clad detached two-storey residence enjoys an enviable position with extensive frontage to Lough Allen and magnificent panoramic views towards the Arigna Mountains to the West and Slieve an Iarainn to the East. At c. 2,200 sq.ft it offers a superb combination of space, quality and natural beauty, this exceptional property provides the perfect opportunity to acquire a substantial lakeside home in one of the region??s most scenic settings. The property is ideally suited as a permanent family residence, a peaceful country retreat or a lakeside holiday home, with the surrounding landscape providing an ever-changing backdrop throughout the seasons. The spacious two-storey house has been designed to make the most of its outstanding setting, with generous accommodation and excellent natural light throughout. With a welcoming entrance hall, two generous reception rooms, offering flexible family and entertaining space. Impressive south-west facing kitchen/dining room, with expansive views across Lough Allen is to the rear of the property. Quality finishes are used throughout throughout, including attractive porcelain tiling, a feature stone fireplace creating a focal point within the living accommodation

The property boasts four large bedrooms, each benefiting from its own ensuite bathroom, providing exceptional comfort and privacy for family and guests. The generous bedroom accommodation, together with the two reception rooms and spacious kitchen/dining area, makes this an ideal home for both everyday family living and entertaining.

One of the property's most outstanding features is its extensive frontage to Lough Allen. The south-west orientation of the kitchen/dining area creates a wonderful space in which to enjoy the surrounding scenery, with broad views extending across the lake towards the dramatic Arigna Mountains. The approximately 12 acre holding offers a rare degree of privacy, space and freedom, while the proximity to the lake and local harbour facilities provides excellent opportunities to enjoy the area's renowned outdoor environment. The nearby Cleighran More Pier and Harbour further enhances the property's appeal, offering convenient access to the lake and its many recreational possibilities. Despite its peaceful rural setting, the property is conveniently located close to local amenities, it is set 1.5 km to Ballinagleragh, and approx. 11 km to Drumshanbo

The area is renowned for its natural beauty, with Lough Allen, the Arigna Mountains and the wider Leitrim landscape providing an exceptional setting for walking, fishing, boating and outdoor pursuits.

The property has a B-rated Building Energy Rating, providing the benefits of a modern, energy-efficient home while retaining the character and appeal of a traditional stone-clad country residence.

This impressive Lough Allen residence offers a unique opportunity to acquire a quality family home in an outstanding location, surrounded by approximately 12 acres of beautiful countryside and overlooking one of Ireland's most scenic lakes. Viewing is by appointment only, with REA Brady.
